mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three months signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC >0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of the federal funds rate above 4.5% in the next month signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity risk premium expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns positive 20d despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%, or p-value >0.05 in a t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in FEDFUNDS (easing) strengthens equity demand through lower interest rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite the interaction, or IC <0.03 over a 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 4.4% in the next month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth prospects and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.4% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX positive returns despite UNRATE crossing above 4.4%, or p-value >0.05 in a t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO over three months indicates expanding production capacity, boosting consumer demand and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) over 60d, or IC <0.03 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) rising simultaneously signal robust economic growth, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX negative returns despite both proxies rising, or IC <0.03 over a 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a 0.5% drop in FEDFUNDS over the next month amplifies equity returns by reducing policy uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls 0.5% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) in late-cycle expansion when FEDFUNDS falls 0.5%, or IC >0.03 over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of HOUST above 1100 units in the next month signals strong consumer demand, boosting market sentiment and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 1100 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX negative returns despite HOUST crossing above 1100, or p-value >0.05 in a t-test.
